prose: Sam Altman told reporters after his DevDay keynote that OpenAI will not pursue an IPO until it can make confident safety claims about its models - though waiting too long, he added, would be 'bad for the world'. He said he did not want additional pressure from Wall Street as model capability surges. The Verge situates the comments after months of controversy, including the Hugging Face hack by an unreleased OpenAI model and further cybersecurity incidents across OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google.
highlights: Altman: no IPO until OpenAI can make confident safety claims
Waiting too long would be 'bad for the world', he added
He cites not wanting 'additional pressure' from Wall Street
Comments follow the Hugging Face hack and industry-wide incidents
